features.name: record_count_5m
features.formula: records for (sensor, sourceIp) key in trailing 5-minute rolling window

features.name: byte_sum_5m
features.formula: byte total for (sensor, sourceIp) key in trailing 5-minute rolling window

features.name: failed_count_5m
features.formula: failed records for (sensor, sourceIp) key in trailing 5-minute rolling window

features.name: inter_arrival_mean_ms
features.formula: running mean interval between records for (sensor, sourceIp) key

features.name: inter_arrival_stddev_ms
features.formula: running population stddev of the inter-arrival interval for (sensor, sourceIp) key

features.name: is_orig
features.formula: 1 if the record was sent by the connection originator else 0

features.name: conn_orig_bytes
features.formula: orig_bytes delta since the previous conn.log snapshot

features.name: conn_resp_bytes
features.formula: resp_bytes delta since the previous conn.log snapshot

features.name: conn_orig_pkts
features.formula: orig_pkts delta since the previous conn.log snapshot

features.name: conn_resp_pkts
features.formula: resp_pkts delta since the previous conn.log snapshot

features.name: conn_age_seconds
features.formula: connection age at the time of the latest conn.log snapshot

features.name: conn_enrichment_present
features.formula: 1 if a conn.log snapshot was available for this record else 0
